text:
Type: gooseneck LED desk lamp
Use: focused task light for reading or working at a desk, or mounted on a wall; home office, study, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: nickel-plated steel base, flexible metal gooseneck arm, small metal cone head
Colors: brushed silver, grey cord
Shape: long arched flexible arm rising from a heavy round disc base, tiny cone spotlight head, light and slender, compact footprint
Feel: sleek, precise, discreet, airy
Goes with: white or glass desks, grey tones, chrome accents; minimalist or modern home offices
